quotes.text: My family thoroughly enjoyed this tour in Hilton Head. Best Price and Best Experience! The captain and first mate were amazing people. They made our trip! We highly recommend this for anyone looking for some fun and really good info about wildlife and the island (and any other questions they can answer for you). Our family decided this was the best afternoon on our trip.
